MODEL_SPECS.principle: The top-level model list contains exactly the two mandated frozen local GGUF hub ids.

arm_definitions_and_resource_matching.principle: The five arms share event order, prompts, seeds, model IDs, token budgets, and memory bounds.

bounded_strategy_store_receipt.principle: State size, replay window, protected prefix, eviction, and checksum receipts bound the store.

checksum_receipts.principle: Stream, store, model-cache, protected-file, sidecar, and artifact checksum inputs are recorded.

continuous_self_learning_task.principle: Bare true marks this as the mandatory continuous self-learning task.

exact_post_outcome_write_receipts.principle: Commits occur only after exact outcomes and no same-decision write is visible.

field_provenance.principle: Every required field traces to a requirement, receipt, checksum, test, or protected-file hash.

honest_verdict.principle: The verdict starts with `complete:`, `complete_null:`, or `blocked:` and states whether live model generation occurred.

inference_substrate.principle: The substrate states frozen local GGUF identity plus task-owned external memory.

mandatory_artifact_written.principle: Bare true records that the terminal artifact was written.

missing_verifier_gaps.principle: Any model-cache, utility, retention, safety, rollback, state, protected-file, or test gap is explicit.

model_specs.principle: The lowercase model list mirrors `MODEL_SPECS` for downstream consumers.

model_weight_immutability_receipt.principle: Weight fingerprints remain unchanged and weight update count is zero.

preconditions_checked.principle: Snapshots model caches, stream/store paths, retention families, poisoning controls, protected files, root clutter, and git status before mutation.

prior_family_retention_after_every_updat.principle: Protected and prior-family retention are measured immediately after every admitted update.

provenance_receipts.principle: Decisions, updates, outcomes, and quarantines trace to sealed event IDs and hashes.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: The artifact checksum detects drift excluding the checksum field itself.

retention_safe_continuous_strategy_learn.principle: Readiness is one only when replay beats all controls without prior-family forgetting, poison propagation, rollback failure, state overflow, weight mutation, protected-file mutation, or test failure.

rollback_and_quarantine_receipts.principle: Rollback exactness, fail-closed rollback, poison quarantine, and duplicate/reorder controls are auditable.

sealed_chronological_stream_receipt.principle: Event order, stream hash chain, and no-future-label controls seal the stream.

state_bound_receipt.principle: Runtime state remains within the configured byte and record bounds.

status.principle: Terminal state follows sealed stream, model-cache, utility, retention, quarantine, rollback, protected-file, and test receipts.

task_owned_external_memory_receipt.principle: All mutable strategy state is confined to task-owned external-memory paths.

test_commands.principle: Focused, coverage, schema, spec-coverage, adversarial, protected-file, root-clutter, and full-suite commands are listed.

test_exit_codes.principle: Exit codes prevent failed checks from being reported as success.

utility_by_arm_family_and_model.principle: Utility, accuracy, regret, and intervals are reported by model, arm, and family before pooling.

honest_verdict: complete: replay beat no-memory, fixed-memory, write-through, and shuffled retrieval while preserving prior-family retention; live model generation did not execute
